core_obligations: Reduce to an integral base: the identity should hold for every triple, and by the vanishing criterion it suffices to prove it after capping with the fundamental class of an integral X, so assume X integral (proof lines 7771-7777).

Move to the projective bundles: let P and P' be the projective bundles of E and of its twist, use the canonical morphism g from P to P' with the property that the pullback of the twisting sheaf is the twisting sheaf of P twisted by the pullback of the invertible sheaf, and write the characterising relation of the Chern classes of the twist on P' after substituting the class xi and the class x represented by the two first Chern classes (proof lines 7777-7800).

Extract the desired relation by algebra: rewrite the resulting sum as a combination of the powers of xi with inner sums over the classes of the twist, compare with the universal relation on the projective bundle of E, and renumber with the signs cleared to obtain the stated binomial expression for the Chern classes of the twist (proof lines 7801-7825).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to an integral base through the vanishing criterion (proof lines 7771-7777).
Use the canonical morphism of projective bundles and the relation of the twisting sheaves (proof lines 7777-7800).
Compare with the universal relation, do the algebra and renumber (proof lines 7801-7825).
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the Chern classes of the twist of a finite locally free sheaf of rank r by an invertible sheaf as a binomial combination of the Chern classes of the original sheaf and powers of the first Chern class of the invertible sheaf (statement lines 7754-7769, tag 02UD). The proof reduces to an integral base by the vanishing criterion, invokes the canonical morphism between the two projective bundles together with the relation between their twisting sheaves, writes the characterising relation of the Chern classes of the twist, and then performs a genuine algebraic manipulation with binomial coefficients to compare that relation with the universal one and extract the formula. The algebra of that comparison is the substance, so the claim is H2.
